consumer_purpose: Governed local inference runtime providing evidence-backed execution, governed streaming admission, stateless tool proposal preflight, and truthful X0 Inference Studio projection. Consumer is the X0 Inference Studio Gridline Interface integration milestone.
production_paths_exercised: RiggedLocalRuntime.execute() → scheduler enqueue → admit → engine.generate (via asyncio.to_thread with _gen_lock)
EvidenceLedger.append() → fcntl LOCK_EX → dedup → predecessor select → schema validate → write → flush → fsync → LOCK_UN
EvidenceLedger.reconstruct() → fcntl LOCK_SH → read → digest validate → chain validate → dup detect → schema validate
RiggedLocalRuntime.build_projection() → truthful X0 consumer contract fields
RiggedInferenceScheduler state machine: queued → running → completed/refused/cancelled/failed with evidence

falsifier_log.assertion: Documented schemas are the canonical validation authority
falsifier_log.attempt: Cross-referenced documented execution and cache schemas against runtime inline validation schemas. Found: documented execution schema requires 9 fields but runtime validates only 3 (receipt_id, status, content_light). Documented cache schema requires 5 fields but runtime validates only 2 (schema_version, content_light). Lifecycle and scheduler schemas match exactly.
falsifier_log.evidence: Execution inline schema: required=['content_light','receipt_id','status'] vs documented: required=9 fields. Cache inline schema: required=['content_light','schema_version'] vs documented: required=5 fields. Runtime is fail-closed against its inline schemas but documented schemas are aspirational, not wired to runtime validation.

untested_claims: Real Apple Silicon acceptance: Qwen3-0.6B-4bit execution proof claimed in acceptance_proof.v1.json but cannot be independently verified without Apple Silicon hardware. Acceptance proof documents its environment honestly.
Request reconstruction from corrupted evidence: tests prove reconstruction detects digest mismatch and chain breaks but do not exercise partial recovery scenarios.
Crash during fsync: no test simulates process termination mid-write to verify on-disk state is recoverable or at least detectable.
Cache write-back path: documented as deferred. LRPUPromptCache read-only reuse verified. Insert-after-generation path tested only as 'pending_low_level_api_integration'.

prepublication_review_cycle: no published prepublication review cycle record found on remote main. Builder compliance gap.
verified_boundary: RiggedInferenceStudioGovernedRuntimeBoundary — narrowed to inference execution governance (admission, streaming, evidence, cache, scheduler, tool proposal preflight). Full tool execution through ToolRuntime.execute_one() explicitly excluded.
downgraded_claims: Documented execution schema (9 required fields) overclaims relative to runtime inline validation (3 required fields). Runtime is fail-closed against inline schemas but documented schemas are aspirational, not the actual validation authority.
Documented cache schema (5 required fields) overclaims relative to runtime inline validation (2 required fields). Same gap as execution schema.

Acceptance proof phrase 'fail_closed_with_real_json_schema_files' is imprecise: scheduler and lifecycle use matching fields; execution and cache use narrower inline schemas, not the documented JSON schema files.

allowed_for: X0 Inference Studio projection integration (read-only projection consumption)
Text generation with governed admission (execute path)
Streaming generation with governed admission (stream_execute path)
Stateless tool proposal preflight (proposal legality evaluation only)

KV cache write-back (requires low-level generate_step API — deferred)

prohibited_for: Claiming tool execution authority before ToolRuntime integration
Claiming full runtime governance before session-context gating is proven
Claiming routed-to-governance status before execution pipeline is complete
Claiming embedding, reranking, or VLM capability (all V1_REQUIRED_PENDING)

freeze_decision.reason: Boundary is published, production-proven for its stated consumer purpose (governed inference execution with evidence-backed admission, streaming, and tool proposal preflight), reconstructable from governing evidence, and free of safety defects inside the boundary. Documented schema specificity gap is deferred (neither blocks safe consumption nor falsifies the boundary claim). Deferred capabilities (full tool execution, cache write-back, continuous batching, SSD persistence, multi-model pools) do not make the released boundary unsafe. Freeze pending X0 Inference Studio Gridline Interface integration milestone or named consumer that wires the projection contract.
